# CoherynUI — Style the next generation.

> CoherynUI is an independent, Rust-native, agent-native UI framework and intelligent styling platform. Its Coheryn CSS Engine produces deterministic, cascade-layered standards-compliant CSS with zero mandatory browser JavaScript.

## Quick Reference
- Official Website: https://coheryntech.com/products/coheryn-ui
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Coheryn/coheryn-ui
- CLI Binary: `coherynui`
- Cascade Layers: `@layer cyn.reset, cyn.tokens, cyn.base, cyn.recipes, cyn.utilities;`
- Token Prefix: `--cyn-*` (configurable in `coherynui.config.toml`)
- MCP Server: `coherynui mcp serve` (stdio JSON-RPC transport)
- Validation: `coherynui check --format json`

## Key Capabilities (Stable 1.0 Release Blockers)
1. Coheryn Components: Headless and React component suite with strict WAI-ARIA 1.2 compliance (`@coherynui/components`, `@coherynui/react`).
2. Coheryn Motion: Analytical harmonic spring solver ($m \cdot x'' + c \cdot x' + k \cdot x = 0$) and FLIP layout transitions (`@coherynui/motion`).
3. Coheryn GPU Materials: 3-tier optical refraction shaders with WebGPU WGSL, WebGL2, and CSS Liquid Glass fallbacks (`@coherynui/gpu-materials`).
4. Coheryn Class Optimizer: Whole-project production AST renaming with `coherynui.manifest.json` bidirectional verification.
5. Coheryn Plugin Host: Sandboxed WebAssembly Component Model plugin runtime with fuel metering.
6. Coheryn MCP Server & Agent Skills: 10 read-only discovery & validation tools with 7 official versioned skills.
